svg.aria-label: Half box times half box is the binary tree; gluing dyadic ends gives the stick
svg.title: Half box times half box is the binary tree; gluing dyadic ends gives the stick

g.text: Join two binary half boxes and you get the binary full box, as a tree
4 pieces at ¼ each step, dimension ½ + ½ = 1
binary tree: each corner = two bits
distances agree within about ×2 either way (check 6b)
= the tree with dyadic ends glued
Binary branching + equal zooms + fair weights pins one half box: two pieces at ¼. Joining it with itself is the full box
as a tree; gluing pairs of ends gives the stick. Lean: four_corner_is_tree, dyadic_glue, pieces_join_closed.
